name: Chylomicron
description: Intestine-derived triglyceride-rich particle transporting dietary lipids from enterocytes to peripheral tissues and liver via lymphatic system
apolipoprotein_composition: APOB-48, APOA1, APOA4, APOC2, APOC3, APOE

name: VLDL
description: Hepatically derived triglyceride-rich particle transporting endogenous triglycerides to peripheral tissues

name: IDL
description: Intermediate-density remnant particle produced from VLDL by LPL-mediated triglyceride hydrolysis; transient plasma intermediate

name: LDL
description: Cholesteryl ester-rich atherogenic particle produced from IDL by hepatic lipase; primary cholesterol delivery particle and principal therapeutic target

name: HDL
description: High-density particle mediating reverse cholesterol transport from peripheral tissues to liver; heterogeneous in size and composition
apolipoprotein_composition: APOA1, APOA2, APOA4, APOC1, APOC2, APOC3, APOE

name: Lp(a)
description: LDL-like particle with apolipoprotein(a) covalently linked to APOB-100 via disulfide bridge; genetically determined by LPA KIV-2 repeat number; independent CVD risk factor

name: Remnant
description: Generic category encompassing partially lipolyzed chylomicron and VLDL remnants (including IDL); atherogenic due to small size and APOE-mediated arterial wall retention
apolipoprotein_composition: APOB-48, APOE (chylomicron remnants); APOB-100, APOE (VLDL remnants)
